title: Decision-curve analysis
primary_chapter_title: Human–AI Decision Systems and Managerial Action
purpose: Compares prediction-model net benefit with treat-all and treat-none strategies across clinically relevant thresholds.
input: `Predictions` sheet with actual outcome and predicted score.
outputs: Decision-curve table and figure, plus the threshold range in which the model provides positive incremental net benefit.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
